name: high-frequency-extension-alternative-skipped
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. Input built by hand: HighFrequencyContainer with its extension bit 1, the normally small non-negative whole number 0 (0 000000, the index of an extension alternative), and an open type of 2 octets (length 0 0000010, then abcd); then lowFrequencyContainer (vehicleRole emergency 6, exteriorLights 00100000, one path point with pathDeltaTime 100). 319 bits. They are the bytes both codecs write for a copy of CAM-PDU-Descriptions whose HighFrequencyContainer has one extension alternative extAlt OCTET STRING (SIZE(2)). Decode skips the alternative (0.19, CHOICE): no key of either alternative. Encode finds no alt with content and writes alt 0, basicVehicleContainerHighFrequency, every component from the pack's defaults (the ASN.1 unavailable values: heading 3601/127, speed 16383/127, driveDirection unavailable, length 1023/unavailable, width 62, acceleration 161/102, curvature 1023/unavailable, curvatureCalculationMode unavailable, yaw rate 32767/unavailable), presence bits 0000000. Expect encoded by both codecs, 52 octets. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
